message.content: {"caption":"Line chart comparing ALFWorld validation success rates with and without skill evolution as training progresses.","description":"A two-series line chart plots Success Rate (vertical axis, 0 to 1) against Training Steps (horizontal axis, 0 to 100). The legend identifies the blue line with circle markers as “w/o Skills Evolution” and the red dashed line with square markers as “w/ Skills Evolution.” The blue series rises unevenly from about 0.10, reaches roughly 0.83 near the later steps, then falls and ends around 0.76. The red series starts near 0.05, rises sharply, and stays around 0.87–0.90 from about step 55 onward; it overtakes the blue series around step 20 and remains generally higher thereafter.
